newsitem.title: THAILAND: One Holding takes Poonpipat stake.
newsitem.headline: One Holding takes Poonpipat stake.

text.p: One Holding Plc, part of Thailand's largest non-bank financial group, said on Monday it had taken a 6.67 percent stake in Poonpipat Finance & Securities Co Ltd.
One Holding said it had acquired 2.8 million shares of Poonpipat on September 25 at a highest price of 69.5 baht. Poonpipat shares closed Monday at 22.5 baht.

Poonpipat chairman Suchart Wanglee said some form of business co-operation with One Holding was likely but said any attempt by One Holdings to enlarge its current stake in Poonpipat was likely to be resisted by the controlling Wanglee family, at least for the time being.
One Holding executives declined to discuss the purchase.
The Wanglee family also control Nakornthon Bank Plc, itself a shareholder in Poonpipat.
One Holding is one of a group of companies headed by expansionist Thai financial magnate Pin Chakkapak. including Securities One Plc and Finance One Plc.
